status: Experimental candidates only. v17 Small-det f16 and v19 Tiny-det/rec q8_0 pass source probability graphs and the tested 50 scene/50 receipt pages on CPU/CUDA/Vulkan. v19 Tiny detector/recognizer contain only 0.23903%/0.57945% Q8_0 parameters; they are explicit mixed-precision experiments, not pure Q8_0 or a compression/speedup claim. Activation calibration uses 256 SHA-pinned training crops and standard ggml Q8_0 bytes. These regressions were used in candidate selection, not untouched held-out certification. Full labelled-page coverage, controlled release-profile A/B, publication and cold-download closure remain mandatory. No policy is a product default; conversion requires explicit --precision-policy and, for the calibrated recipe, --calibration-root.
